$comment: Beyonder baseline settings, written by beyonder-setup into .claude/settings.json (committed). Merge, never overwrite. Rule grammar: ':*' means prefix matching and MUST be the last thing in the rule; anywhere else use a plain '*' wildcard — rules that break this are silently skipped at load time. Evaluation is deny → ask → allow, first match wins, specificity ignored, and a deny rule cannot carry an exception. Two consequences: (a) allowed readers like grep/python3 can read what the Read-deny rules protect — the deny list is a guardrail against accidents, not a sandbox; (b) because no exception is possible, env files are denied BY NAME. Don't try 'Read(**/.env.*)': it also swallows .env.example/.sample/.template/.dist — committed placeholder files setup and later sessions legitimately read — and no allow rule can ever win them back. Add new names here as they appear; never a '.env.*' wildcard.
$comment.hooks: SessionEnd cleanup, two rules (E-0026). RULE 1 — WHAT THE CLI MANAGES, NO HOOK TOUCHES: the browser CLI owns '.claude/skills/playwright-cli/' (its docs) and '.playwright/' (its config); no hook here may name either — the rule is the rule, not the two names. What this hook cleans is '.playwright-cli/', the CLI's scratch OUTPUT (snapshots, traces/, the default state-save target): output is ours to age, configuration is not. RULE 2 — AGE, DON'T EMPTY: only files older than 7 days are deleted (the CLI's own recommendation). Don't try 'find .playwright-cli -mindepth 1 -delete': a report, MR note or ticket linking a trace then points into nothing the next morning. The other half of the rule lives in the skills: anything a report links is captured with an explicit --filename= into the run's artifact directory, which no hook ever empties (vendor/skills/shared/browser-discipline.md, 'Where artifacts go, and what may age'). '.playwright-cli/' must be gitignored (beyonder-setup step 1, item 6) — 'state-save' with no argument writes a live session's cookies and tokens into it.
